notes.note: Grepped for event store, persistence, journal and ledger claims; none depend on the hub. The implementation route cites flow/evidence services instead.

The only usage-receipt mention is a terminology boundary pointing to the usage-telemetry reference, not a claim about how the hub stores receipts; other claims route to scheduler/notification/telemetry owners.

The server-side steer/queue claims are implemented by the thread inbox store (persist-before-claim, head fence, unconfirmed state) and the post-tool inbox; EventStore only lazily constructs the inbox over its handle. Queued file bytes live in the attachment blob store.

The doc never mentions EventStore; its persistence claims are implemented in the working-state worker and the 512 KiB CHECK is in migration 008, neither of which is cited. The hub only forwards its database path.
